english.note: Use this for having little or no money or possessions.

exampleSentences.english: I used to be poor and couldn't even afford food.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我以前好窮，連飯都食唔起。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 hou2 kung4 lin4 faan6 dou1 sik6 m4 hei2

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is poor or lacks basic material means.

exampleSentences.english: This charity specializes in helping needy people.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢間慈善機構專門幫窮人。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3 zyun1 mun4 bong1 kung4 jan4

english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a person or community reduced to poverty.

exampleSentences.english: Their family is so impoverished that they cannot afford enough food.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢哋一家窮到連飯都食唔飽。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 kung4 dou3 lin4 faan6 dou1 sik6 m4 baau2
